title: NY couple spend $3M on a home for their dog; now sell for $2.9M
summary_full: Howard and Suze Rubin moved their home to New York for their dog. They spent nearly three million dollars renovating the house for Buster's needs. The property features a custom pool and shaded outdoor areas for the dog. This unique home, designed for canine comfort, is now on the market. The couple seeks to return to Florida after enjoying their time in New York.
